name: Defeat All Enemies
_source: s;Master_of_Arms;Congrats, Shin Hakkyoku school!{c:wait;400} You guys win this year Tenraisai!|You have done well despite your master went missing.
s;Shen;Zip it.{c:wait;400} If that old man was here, he would only make things more difficult of us.
s;Master_of_Arms;Haha! Quite so,{w} Master Feng never understood how to fight as a team.|Anyways, here's this year prize.
s;Master_of_Arms;Hey, you can hand them the Elixir now.
s;Master_of_Arms;That's fool!{c:wait;400} He went and touched it!
s;Mui;H-he lost his mind from holding too many <violet>Artifacts</>...
s;Master_of_Arms;I will make him snap out of it.
s;Andy;Shen! Get Mui and Fuuko back, then we handle him togeth-
s;Shen;No. This guy is a full-blown martial master, so he is my fight!{w} Please, don't get in my way.
s;Fuuko;Mr. Shen! Calm down and think!|What's the actual reason for your obsession with getting stronger?
s;Fuuko;Wrong!{c:wait;400} It's to protect others. That's the truth, isn't it?
s;Andy;Shen, instead of risking your life for a combat high,|focus on protecting what you hold dear.
s;Mui;He's heading this way! Watch out, Master Shen!

s;Shen;Jingcai!{c:wait;400} All I did was focusing on protecting Mui,{w}{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes} but I'm positive,{c:wait;400} as it stands,{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;CloseEyes} that I'm the strongest I've ever been.
s;Andy;Sick.{c:wait;400} Wicked sick!{w} You've weaken him enough, leave it to me and Fuuko to handle the rest.
s;Fuuko;Andy, we can end this with Unluck.
s;;Andy and Fuuko is preparing for an <red>Unluck</> special move.|To do so, first <yellow>move Fuuko next to Andy</> and <yellow>use Unluck</> on him.;;;Tutorial

name: Fuuko Death

name: Intro
_source: choice;choice_tutorial;<yellow>Neutralize UMA Tutorial?</>;True|Not yet. I've never played Fire Emblem, False|Sure. I already know basic Fire Emblem;;vert;bottom
s;;The world began with only man and earth.;;;Narrator
s;;Then, God added <red>Rules</>, along with the <red>UMAs</> that embodied them:;;;Narrator;no_block;hold
s;;<yellow>{rule}</>;{e:100 + (1 if game.get_random(0, 1) else -1) * game.get_random(24,100)},{e: 56 + (1 if game.get_random(0, 1) else -1) * game.get_random(24,40)};;clear;;;text;no_block;hold
s;;Make no mistake, there isn't a single rule designed to aid men's survival.;;;Narrator

s;;And yet, mankind's hope only grew stronger.|Fighting the UMAs is <yellow>the UNION</>,{c:sound;FireBall}{c:add_region;vision_ragnarok;7,19;1,1;vision;4}|an organisation of <yellow>Negators</> specialized in hunting <yellow>UMAs</>, completing <yellow>Quests</>, and combating <red>God</>.|At the center of the Union lies the <yellow>Roundtable</>, where only their main members can take seats.|And, no matter what,{c:wait;400} only <yellow>the Leader</> can take the first seat.;;;Narrator
s;;"Unluck" Fuuko Izumo.{w} Along with "Undead" Andy, this is the story of their quest against God,{w} for a world freed from unjust rules and hardships.;;;Narrator

s;Juiz;Fuuko,{c:wait;400} you are now this organisation's new boss.{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes}{c:wait;100}{c:e;Fuuko;OpenEyes}|The new UNION is in your han-{c:move_portrait;Fuuko;CenterRight;2;no_block}{c:screen_shake;400;celeste;no_block}{c:bop;Juiz;1;no_block}{c:e;Fuuko;CloseEyes}

s;Fuuko;Ms. Juiz...{c:wait;800} I'm afraid I can't reassure you.{c:wait;800} I'm far too weak.|{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes}But...{c:wait;800}{c:e;Fuuko;HalfCloseEyes} Mr. Victor told me once before,{c:wait;400} that I was just like you, Ms. Juiz.|That I was willing to bet it all for them.{c:wait;800} That spirit-{c:wait;400}that <blue>Soul</>-That was what I had!|So I-{c:wait;400}I know that much is certainly true.|It's thanks to the UNION that I got to be this way, after all.
s;Juiz;No...{c:wait;400} It's your hard work that moves other people's hearts to help you.|So thank you, Fuuko.
s;Andy;Juiz!{c:wait;400} Those tremors just keep getting bigger.

s;Juiz;Fuuko.{c:wait;400} Our job begins from this point on.{c:wait;800} Please have faith and wait here.|Now that I'm no longer the leader, I can finally fight. I'll be off now...{c:wait;400} boss!|I will risk my life along with the others to ensure that you go through the loop.
s;Fuuko;Ah...{c:wait;400} everyone...{c:wait;400} risking their lives again...

s;Andy;Don't tell me this late in the game, you're blaming yourselves for everyone dying or whatever!|Listen, all we do right now is grab hold of the baton that everyone has passed to us...|So that the two of us can go through the loop, get stronger and come out on top!|Ain't that right?
s;Andy;You got it, chief.{c:wait;400} Catch ya on the flip side, Fuuko!

s;Juiz;Yes. That is God.{c:wait;400} <bconvo><red>Sun</></>.{w}{clear}Listen up, UNION!{c:wait;400} This is my last order to you as former boss!|This is Ragnarok-The very end of the world.{c:wait;400} So don't hesitate to risk your lives.|For these last few minutes,{c:wait;400} give it our all to stop God from reaching Fuuko!|Operation...{c:wait;400} STARTS!

name: Union Reinforcement
_source: s;Mui;Master Shen,{c:wait;400} a-are we all that's left?
s;Shen;My dear Mui,{c:wait;400} I'm afraid we don't have much time either.|Let us not worry about death and ensure Fuuko make it to the next loop!
s;Mui;Even then, I remain hopeful...{c:wait;800} that the seven of us survive,{c:wait;400} just for these last few minutes.

name: Outro
_source: if;all(game.check_alive(unit_nid) for unit_nid in game.level.unit_groups.get('Union').units) and game.check_alive('Juiz_100')
s;Mui;Ms. Fuuko, a gift to the next loop!
s;Fuuko;All of you,{c:wait;400} thank you.|{c:e;Fuuko;OpenEyes}{c:bop;Fuuko;no_block}Now it's time to go!

name: Unit Death
_source: s;Colour;Y-you dare killing an UMA?!{c:wait;400} The very embodiment of a Rule?!|You shall suffer the consequence of that r-right now!
s;Melody;Takesss away Melody,{c:wait;400} and thisss world will forever sssink in sssilence.
s;Juiz;Victor, it's amazing isn't it?{c:wait;400} We pulled together...{c:wait;400}{c:e;{unit};CloseEyes,Smile} some amazing allies.

s;Mui;Oh, Master Shen!{c:wait;400} It's gonna be okay now. {c:wait;400}{c:move_portrait;Mui;120,80} I'm right here...|You know, meals always tasted best when I was with you, Master Shen...|because you looked at me with so much affection.|So please...{c:wait;400} in the next loop, can I be by your side once again?
s;Shen;Yes, of course.{c:wait;400} If you will agree to have me.|And this time I will make you the happiest you've ever been.

s;Shen;Mui...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;HalfCloseEyes} Mui, my dear.|Life before you came...{c:wait;400} was a mindless, murderous world.{c:wait;400} You brought me peace, kindness, and love.| I have been in love you, and will always be until the day I die.

s;Rip;Were my efforts...{c:wait;400} going to help changing fates?|No...{c:wait;400} it wasn't just me. You two were there...{c:wait;400} every step of the way...|{c:e;Rip;CloseEyes}Goodnight...{c:wait;400} Leila...{c:wait;400} Latla...

name: Final Push
_source: s;Andy;Everyone!{c:wait;400} Fuuko!{c:wait;400} This is the final push!{c:wait;400} Hold on just a little longer!

s;Juiz;With bitter regrets of my late comrades.|With my own powerlessness.|With the rage of the torment you caused us these last 455.4 billion undying years.|{c:e;Juiz;OpenEyes}I'll imbue all of those rage in this last attack against you,{c:bop;Juiz;no_block} God!
s;Shen;Let's show them what Shin Hakkyouku is made of together!
s;Shen;Mui, all I did was looking back at the warm memories you had given me.|{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes}But, I'm positive,{c:wait;400} as it's stands, I'm the strongest I've ever been.
s;Mui;Master Shen.{c:wait;400} You have given me both mighty words and power that are mine to use.|I shall live up to the call,{c:wait;400} all through these eyes devoid of lies!

s;Rip;They can be a UMA or God, it doesn't matter.{c:wait;400} I'm going to save everything I hold dear.|If fate decides to take away my happy ending right before my eyes...|then I'd refute and{c:bop;Juiz;no_block} negate that fate!

s;Fuuko;Gods, you may have toyed with us for hundreds of billions of years...|but it seems you still don't know negators.|What gave us strength.{c:wait;400} What pushed us to live.{c:wait;400} What shaped us and held us together...|has always been this feeling that we gain from those we hold dear.|{c:bop;Fuuko;no_block}Do not underestimate us!

name: Intro
_source: s;Announcer;Welcome back, folks!{c:wait;400} It's the moment you've been waiting for!|Let's get Tenraisai,{c:wait;400} the annual tournament to decide the strongest martial artist,{c:wait;400} underway!;0,24
s;Announcer;I-it's a knockout!{c:wait;400} Another full point for Shen Xiang of the Shin Hakkyoku school!;0,24
s;Shen;Haaa...{c:wait;400} The participants this year sure are disappointing.
s;Shen;Oh, it's you, Mui...{c:wait;400} Hmm?|{c:bop;Shen;no_block}Come clean, Mui! You're using another new <violet>Artifact</>, aren't you?
s;Mui;No, y-you see, this just arrived a moment ago...
s;Shen;It's like I keep telling you,{c:wait;400} using too many artifacts will destroy your mind!
s;Mui;But, sir...{c:wait;400} I am ill-equipped without negator abilities of my own.|At the very least, I wish to pay you back for participating in this tournament for me.

s;Shen;Nope. You got it all wrong.{c:wait;400} I joined Tenraisai this year solely to grow stronger,|to become the strongest in all creation. That's the truth.|Getting the prize, the medicine for your brother, will be a lucky coincidence.|Just wait outside, I will win this tournament myself.
s;Announcer;What a sneak attack!{c:wait;400} The invincible Shen Xiang is now completely vulnerable!;0,24
s;Bandit;Hahaha! Do I hear that right? Ya want to win this alone?|It's group effort that counts, ya know.{c:wait;400} So let's see how one brat fare against my entire group!
s;Andy;How 'bout making it a four-man team?;0,24
s;Fuuko;Mr. Shen! Mui!{c:wait;400} Are you two okay?
s;Mui;W-who are you?{c:wait;400} And how do you know our names?
s;Andy;Just now you said your reason for fighting is to be the strongest.|That ain't the truth, isn't it?
s;Shen;Just what are you talking about? State your names!
s;Fuuko;We are UNION, an ally to all <violet>Negators</>.{c:wait;400} Let us help!

s;Shen;Okay. No.{c:wait;400} UNION? Never heard of you.|So we've only just met, you really think we can trust you right away?|Besides, I alone can win this tournament.{c:wait;400} They will be my fuel to grow even stronger.
s;Mui;But Master Shen,{c:wait;400} there are clear dirty fightings involved inthis Tenraisai.
s;Andy;Lil' Miss here speaks the truth, you know.|And with that injury?{c:wait;400} Forget winning, can you even protect your girlfriend?
s;Mui;B-bushi!{c:wait;400} I'm just a disciple of Master Shen. T-there's nothing more than that!
s;Fuuko;Mr. Shen, you do understand right?{c:wait;400} The truth behind strength.|Individual strength is not all there is.{c:wait;400} So, please, you can count on us.
s;Shen;...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;CloseEyes}{c:bop;Shen;no_block}Urgh! Fine! Do as you please!|{c:e;Shen;OpenEyes}But leave their strongest one to me.
s;Announcer;What's this? We have two new contenders, folks!|And they have joined force with the outcast Shin Hakkyoku pair!;0,24
s;Mui;Master Shen, though you insist that you aren't doing this for my sake,|I would feel less guilty if you can enjoy the rest of your time here.
s;Shen;Haaa...{c:wait;400}{c:e;Shen;Smile,HalfCloseEyes} now that those two have liven things up, I might as well have some fun.

name: Tutorial Unluck 1
_source: s;;Now Andy is a <red>ticking time bomb</>! Move Fuuko safely away from him.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial Unluck 2
_source: s;;Finally, <yellow>move Andy next to the target</> and end your turn.|A meteorite will soon hit Andy and anyone nearby.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial Heal
_source: s;Mui;Master Shen! You are still injured from their sneak attack.|I have prepared a <brown>Panpanda</> in your inventory. Please use it to heal yourself up.

name: Tutorial Weapon Triangle
condition: v('choice_tutorial') and unit.team == 'player' and combat_calcs.compute_advantage_attr(unit, unit2, item, unit2.get_weapon(), 'accuracy') < 0
_source: s;;That won't do.{c:wait;400} You're limiting your unit's fighting potentials.{w} Let me teach you this neat trick:{br}Physical weapons possess a unique hierachy.|<red>Swords</><icon>Swords</> best <green>Guantlets</><icon>Brutes</>.|<green>Guantlets</><icon>Brutes</> best <blue>Spears</><icon>Spears</>.|<blue>Spears</><icon>Spears</> best <red>Swords</><icon>Swords</>.|This is called the Weapon Triangle.|Using the correct weapons against the enemy will grant damage and accuracy boost.|Using the wrong weapons, however, then your damage and accuracy will suffer.|<orange>Guns</><icon>Firearms</> are not affected by the Weapon Triangle.;;;Tutorial

name: Tutorial Terrain
_source: s;;Was that enemy surprisingly hard to hit?|Look closely, he is maneuvering around that pillar to evade attacks.|Maybe this can be a lesson for you: Tactically position your units on some special terrains,|and your units will be able to make full use of the surroundings to dodge enemies' attacks,|increase defenses{w} or even recover some health back.;;;Tutorial

name: Outro
_source: s;Mui;You went out cold after blocking that martial master full attack.|But thanks to your effort, Mr. Andy and Ms. Fuuko was able to knock him out.|I've safely gotten the Elixir and gave it to my brother.|{c:e;Mui;Smile}He's made a full recovery.
s;Shen;Oh, good.{c:wait;400} So that was worth it then.|And where are those two?{c:wait;400} I have some questions to ask them.
s;Andy;Your move back then,{c:wait;400} making the enemy hit themselves.|That's your negation, Untruth, isn't it?
s;Shen;...Yes, I can sometimes make my target's attack backfire just by looking.|The chances are unreliable, though. It depends on my dexterity.
s;Mui;Ms. Fuuko,{c:wait;400} you said that UNION is an ally to all Negators.|I can tell that both you and Mr. Andy are Negators as well.|Then are you here to recruit Master Shen?
